key.name: update-interval
key.description: Download interval (in minutes) for all RSS feeds.

key.name: items-visible
key.description: How many articles each feed (Classic) or section (Minimal) shows before 'Show more'.

key.name: items-retained
key.description: How many articles are stored per feed. Articles that drop out of the feed stay stored until the feed goes over this limit, then the oldest ones are removed.

key.name: max-height
key.description: Maximum popup menu height (in pixels) before it starts scrolling.

key.name: notification-limit
key.description: Maximum number of notifications shown at once

key.name: mark-initial-as-new
key.description: When enabled, items fetched on the first poll are marked as unread.

key.name: display-mode
key.description: Controls whether the panel icon/menu, notifications, or both are shown. One of: 'notifications-and-widget', 'notifications-only', 'widget-only'.

key.name: prefs-open-sources
key.summary: Open preferences on the Sources page
key.description: Set by the panel menu so the preferences window opens directly on the Sources page. Reset once the window is built.

key.name: show-failed-feeds
key.description: Show a pill in the menu header with the number of feeds that failed to update.

key.name: group-notifications-by-source
key.description: Show a separate notification group per feed instead of pooling all notifications under one shared source.

key.name: hover-action-1
key.description: Action of the first button shown when hovering over an article. One of: 'none', 'read', 'star', 'dismiss', 'older', 'copy', 'open'.

key.name: hover-action-2
key.description: Action of the second button shown when hovering over an article. One of: 'none', 'read', 'star', 'dismiss', 'older', 'copy', 'open'.

key.name: hover-action-3
key.description: Action of the third button shown when hovering over an article. One of: 'none', 'read', 'star', 'dismiss', 'older', 'copy', 'open'.

key.name: click-action-left
key.description: What a left click on an article does. One of: 'openread', 'open'.

key.name: click-action-middle
key.description: What a middle click on an article does. One of: 'none', 'openread', 'open', 'read', 'star', 'dismiss', 'older', 'copy'.

key.name: click-action-right
key.description: What a right click on an article does. One of: 'none', 'openread', 'open', 'read', 'star', 'dismiss', 'older', 'copy'.
